sn38.4:1.1: āvuso Sāriputta samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti || ||
sn38.4:1.2: Dukkhassa kho āvuso pariññattham Bhagavati brahmacariyam vussatīti || || 3
sn38.4:1.3: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || ||
sn38.4:1.4: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || || 4
sn38.4:1.5: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || ||
sn38.4:2.1: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa dukkhassa pariññāya || seyyathīdam ||
sn38.4:2.3: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāyāti || 5
sn38.4:2.4: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa dukkhassa pariññāya ||
